render.prompt: Locked-off 35 mm wide side view, static camera, no push, no zoom, no pan, one single unbroken twelve-second take from this one camera only. Start exactly from the first frame and continue the same continuous take without any cut; the camera never changes position, height or angle. The wooden jetty running from the shore at the right out over the lake to the left, the small rowing boat moored at its end, the explorer in the khaki safari jacket and pith helmet walking along it toward the boat with his back to the camera, and exactly two steps behind him the young man in the lime-green bucket hat (soft, round-shouldered, heavy-set, washed-out grey hoodie, giant black headphones round his neck, baggy black cargo shorts, long white tube socks in black slides) copying his every step with his phone held up in one hand and his can in the other. The explorer reaches the end of the jetty, steps down into the boat, sits, takes the oars and pushes off toward the left. Two steps behind him and looking at his phone, the young man copies the same step down off the end of the jetty, where there is now only water, and drops straight into the lake with a splash, hat and phone and can and all. The explorer rows away toward the left without looking back, and the young man surfaces beside the jetty in his hat, holding the phone up out of the water. Sound: boots and slides on planks, the boat knocking the jetty, oars dipping, one big splash, spluttering, a loon far off.
